value: Founded in February 2005 by Chad Hurley, Steve Chen, and Jawed Karim, YouTube swiftly transformed from an innovative video-sharing concept into a dominant global platform after its acquisition by Google in November 2006. As the world's second-most popular website, it empowers users to upload, view, and interact with a vast array of user-generated and corporate video content. Throughout its rapid evolution, YouTube has continuously introduced and refined features, from live streaming and diverse video formats to monetization programs and subscription services, while simultaneously grappling with persistent criticisms concerning content moderation, including copyright, algorithmic influence, and user safety.
